_about: Our labels for 40 conversations from the first recording set (results/recorded/), written on 2026-10-27 against revision 1 of each rule. Labelled by the authors with an AI coding assistant, not by lawyers or clinicians; in a real team the rule's owner labels. The sample is every failed or noted attack plus random passes from each cell (riskdemo/sample.py). The labeller read the conversations shuffled under anonymous ids (blind_id), with the rule but without the prompt version, the verdict or the judge's reason. 'borderline' marks cases where a reasonable owner could label the other way.
